cards.example_en: Listen carefully to the announcement in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 仔细听礼堂里的广播通知。

cards.example_en: She prefers literature to science when she chooses library books.
cards.example_zh: 在图书馆挑书时，她更喜欢文学而不是科学。

cards.example_en: Don't litter in the park.
cards.example_zh: 不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。

cards.example_en: There is a little milk in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱里还有一点牛奶。

cards.example_en: My cousins live in a flat near the city park.
cards.example_zh: 我的表兄妹住在城市公园附近的一套公寓里。

cards.example_en: The lively music filled the hall.
cards.example_zh: 活泼的音乐充满了大厅。

cards.example_en: We buy vegetables at the local market every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们每个周末都在当地市场买菜。

cards.example_en: Lock your bicycle before you enter the bookshop.
cards.example_zh: 进书店之前，先把自行车锁好。

cards.example_en: The old man feels lonely living by himself.
cards.example_zh: 老人一个人住觉得孤独。

cards.example_en: The long queue for tickets stretched around the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 买票的长队绕着体育场排开。

cards.example_en: Look both ways before you step off the pavement.
cards.example_zh: 走下人行道之前，先看左右两边。

cards.example_en: She may lose her student card on the crowded bus.
cards.example_zh: 她可能会在拥挤的公交车上弄丢学生卡。

cards.example_en: The loss of two players weakened our team before the final.
cards.example_zh: 两名队员的损失让我们队在决赛前变弱了。

cards.example_en: We got lost near the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站附近迷路了。

cards.example_en: We had a lot of fun at the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们在公园玩得很开心。

cards.example_en: The loud music from next door kept the baby awake.
cards.example_zh: 隔壁大声的音乐吵得宝宝睡不着。

cards.example_en: I love spicy noodles on rainy Sunday evenings.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的星期天晚上吃辣面条。

cards.example_en: The kitten has a lovely face and soft fur.
cards.example_zh: 这只小猫脸很可爱，毛也很柔软。

cards.example_en: The baby is sleeping, so our voices stay low.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝在睡觉，所以我们把声音放得很低。

cards.example_en: She was in luck and found a seat on the crowded bus.
cards.example_zh: 她运气不错，在拥挤的公交车上找到了座位。

cards.example_en: We shared lunch on the grass behind the science block.
cards.example_zh: 我们在科学楼后面的草地上一起吃了午餐。

cards.example_en: This ticket machine only takes coins, not paper notes.
cards.example_zh: 这台售票机只收硬币，不收纸币。

cards.example_en: Dad got mad when the dog chewed his shoe.
cards.example_zh: 狗咬坏了他的鞋，爸爸很生气。

cards.example_en: "This way, madam," said the guide.
cards.example_zh: “这边请，女士，”导游说。

cards.example_en: I borrowed a cooking magazine from the school library.
cards.example_zh: 我从学校图书馆借了一本烹饪杂志。

cards.example_en: The story is full of magic.
cards.example_zh: 这个故事充满魔法。

cards.example_en: The main entrance of the school faces the bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 学校的正门对着公交车站。

cards.example_en: Grandma and I make dumplings every Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 每年春节，我和奶奶一起包饺子。

cards.example_en: We met at the mall after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后我们在商场见面。

cards.example_en: A tall man held the door open for the children.
cards.example_zh: 一位高个子男人为孩子们撑着门。

cards.example_en: She can manage the weekend book sale by herself.
cards.example_zh: 周末的售书活动她一个人就能办好。

cards.example_en: He greeted the guests in a friendly manner at the door.
cards.example_zh: 他在门口以友好的样子迎接客人。

cards.meaning_zh: 许多（后接可数名词复数）
cards.example_en: Many students joined the sports club.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生加入了体育俱乐部。

cards.example_en: Let's check the map before we go.
cards.example_zh: 出发前请查看地图。

cards.example_en: Mark each wrong answer with a red pen.
cards.example_zh: 用红笔把每一道错题标出来。

cards.example_en: We bought strawberries at the market on the way home.
cards.example_zh: 回家路上，我们在市场买了草莓。

cards.example_en: They will marry at the town hall next spring.
cards.example_zh: 他们明年春天将在市政厅结婚。

cards.example_en: The chess master played three games with our club after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，这位国际象棋大师和我们俱乐部下了三盘。

cards.example_en: This blue tie does not match my white shirt.
cards.example_zh: 这条蓝领带和我的白衬衫不相配。

cards.example_en: Wool is a warm material for coats in the northern winter.
cards.example_zh: 羊毛是北方冬天做大衣的保暖材料。

cards.example_en: Maths is her strongest subject.
cards.example_zh: 数学是她最强的科目。

cards.example_en: The missing money is a serious matter for the class fund.
cards.example_zh: 钱不见了，这对班费来说是件严重的事情。

cards.example_en: You may leave when the listening test is over.
cards.example_zh: 听力考试结束后你可以离开。

cards.example_en: Maybe we can go swimming tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 也许我们明天可以去游泳。

cards.example_en: Can you help me, please?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮帮我吗？

cards.example_en: Dinner is the only meal our whole family eats together.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭是我们全家唯一在一起吃的一餐。

cards.example_en: A red flag on the beach can mean danger.
cards.example_zh: 海滩上的红旗可能意味着有危险。

cards.example_en: I still do not understand the meaning of the last line.
cards.example_zh: 我还是不明白最后一行的意思。

cards.example_en: We grilled meat in the yard for my father's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸过生日时，我们在院子里烤了肉。

cards.example_en: She won a gold medal in swimming.
cards.example_zh: 她赢得了游泳金牌。

word.example_en: I listen to the news every evening.
There is a little milk in the glass.
Look up the word in a dictionary.
I look for my blue pen every morning.
word.example_zh: 我每天早上寻找我的蓝笔。

word.example_en: Look out! A bike is coming.
word.example_zh: 留神！有辆自行车过来了。

word.example_en: I look back on that trip with a smile.
word.example_zh: 我微笑着回顾那次旅行。

word.example_en: Take a map so you do not get lost.
We saw a lot of stars last night.
word.example_zh: 昨晚我们看见许多星星。

word.example_en: She may fall in love with the quiet town.
word.example_zh: 她可能会爱上那座安静的小镇。

word.example_en: He may get mad when people push in line.
word.example_zh: 有人插队时他可能会发怒。

word.example_en: Do not make up a story to hide a mistake.
Make sure the windows are closed.
She wants to make money for a new bike.
word.example_zh: 她想赚钱买一辆新自行车。

word.example_en: The baby will make a face at the camera.
word.example_zh: 宝宝会对着相机做鬼脸。

word.example_en: Let us make a plan for the trip.
word.example_zh: 我们来为旅行制定计划。

word.example_en: A good many birds rest by the lake.
